crossRefs.note: “Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Should the women eat their offspring, the children that they held…
Remember, Yahweh, what has come on us. Look, and see our reproach.
Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
For he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, Yahweh saw the earth;
to hear the groans of the prisoner; to free those who are condemned to death;
I have set watchmen on your walls, Jerusalem. They will never be silent day nor night. You who call on Yahweh, take no…
and give him no rest, until he establishes, and until he makes Jerusalem a praise in the earth.
Look down from heaven, and see from the habitation of your holiness and of your glory. Where are your zeal and your…
Oh that you would tear the heavens, that you would come down, that the mountains might quake at your presence.
Lord, according to all your righteousness, let your anger and please let your wrath be turned away from your city…

parallels.note: Yahweh looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

translations.web: until Yahweh looks down, and sees from heaven.
translations.bsb: until the LORD looks down from heaven and sees.
translations.kjv: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
translations.asv: Till Jehovah look down, and behold from heaven.
